AboutIntro.title: Educating to transform
AboutIntro.description: Waza and Act is an independent and impartial NGO, with no religious or political affiliation, based in Goma (DRC). Founded by Mr. Sebijumba Augustin, a dedicated teacher, it supports vulnerable young people facing a rapidly changing world and adults weakened by life's hardships, by promoting education, dignity and the autonomy of communities.
AboutIntro.imageAlt: Waza and Act, an NGO based in Goma

items.youth: young people supported back to school

MissionVision.title: A clear mission, an ambitious vision and

mission.title: Our mission
mission.description: Our mission is to promote education, dignity and the autonomy of communities, by supporting vulnerable young people and adults weakened by life's hardships.

vision.title: Our vision
vision.description: Our vision is of a Congolese society where everyone, whatever their story, has the power to make their own decisions and transform their destiny.

values.title: Our values
values.description: Our values are independence, impartiality, dignity, education and autonomy: they guide every action we take, with no religious or political affiliation.

education.title: School support for vulnerable young people
education.description: Tutoring, school supplies and personalised follow-up so that every young person can return to or continue their education.

formation.title: Vocational training for adults
formation.description: Hands-on workshops to help adults weakened by life's hardships find a trade and an income again.

communaute.title: Community dialogue and awareness
communaute.description: Neighbourhood meetings to promote education, dignity and peaceful coexistence among residents.

autonomie.title: Support for local self-reliance initiatives
autonomie.description: Guidance for projects led by young people and families, so they become the drivers of their own future.

Testimonials.title: What they
Testimonials.description: What our partners and beneficiaries say about Waza and Act’s support

t1.quote: Thanks to Waza and Act, we gained a better understanding of community needs and were able to adapt our field activities accordingly. The support was practical and attentive.
t1.name: Amina Niyonkuru

t2.quote: The Waza and Act team created a meaningful dialogue between partners and communities. This participatory approach strengthened trust and local engagement.
t2.name: Jean-Claude Mukendi

t3.quote: We appreciated the attentive listening and rigorous follow-up. Waza and Act’s recommendations helped us make our response more relevant and inclusive.
t3.name: Chantal Uwase

t4.quote: Waza and Act supported us with professionalism and a clear understanding of the realities on the ground. Our collaboration helped mobilise local stakeholders around shared goals.
t4.name: Patrick Bahati

t5.quote: I particularly appreciated the focus on involving the people affected. Their experiences and priorities genuinely guided the planning and activities.
t5.name: Grace Mutesi

t6.quote: Working with Waza and Act helped our team strengthen its practices and coordinate more effectively with local partners. The support was tailored to our needs.
t6.name: Samuel Kamanzi

story.title: A belief rooted in
story.paragraph1: Waza and Act grew from the wish of Mr Sebijumba Augustin, a committed teacher and respected adviser, to address the educational needs of the Congolese people.

foundation.title: Founded in Rutshuru

hero.title: Support
hero.description: Choose the transfer method that works for you. You can send your donation directly through Airtel Money or Access Bank.

methods.question: Which donation methods are available?
methods.answer: You can transfer through Airtel Money to +243 991 901 271, or make a bank transfer to the Access Bank account listed on this page.

websitePayment.question: Is payment processed on this website?
websitePayment.answer: No. This website displays the transfer details; the transfer is completed through Airtel Money or your banking app.

recurring.question: Can I set up a monthly donation?
recurring.answer: The website does not set up automatic monthly payments. To discuss regular support, contact Waza and Act.

verification.question: What should I check before confirming a transfer?
verification.answer: Check the number or bank details you entered and verify the beneficiary name shown in your app.

international.question: Can I make a bank transfer from abroad?
international.answer: Access Bank’s SWIFT code is ABNGCDKI. Before transferring, check with your bank which currency is accepted and whether any fees apply.

fees.question: Can transfer fees apply?
fees.answer: Fees may depend on your Airtel Money provider, bank and transfer type. Check the terms with your provider before confirming.
